Products and access

IC and LC Inquiry Checklist

An online checklist with 43 tickable checks. One organisation may use this edition internally through the original buyer account for 120 days from verified payment capture. Ticks stay in the browser used to mark them. Future editions are separate.

Inquiry Essential

One authorised proceeding. Two seats including the buyer. Six calendar months of editing with the guided workflow, core Word drafts and Readiness Toolkit.

Inquiry Professional

One authorised proceeding. Five seats including the buyer. Nine calendar months of editing. Includes Essential’s core tools, evidence-linked question planning, an editable 44-section report draft and three readiness reviews.

Inquiry Advanced

One authorised proceeding. Eight seats including the buyer. Twelve calendar months of editing. Includes Professional’s tools, complex-proceeding exercises, coded continuity drafts and service-rule profiles.

The editing term starts when Navigator verifies the captured payment and activates the plan. The buyer can assign available seats to confirmed accounts during that term. Three further calendar months allow authorised users to review a saved local recovery file. Editing, new draft generation and seat changes end when editing access ends. Save your recovery file and export any drafts you need before then. There is no automatic renewal.

When offered for paid purchase, each separate individual advanced guide provides one account with 90 days of access from activation, eight preparation stages, nine Word drafts and a local planner. Institutional Plus and Government or Enterprise work requires an agreed written proposal or quotation.

Permitted use and Committee responsibility

Use individual credentials and keep downloaded materials within the licensed purpose. Share completed inquiry documents only with authorised recipients. Resale and public redistribution of the checklist or template library are prohibited.

The competent Committee remains responsible for the applicable procedure, assessment of evidence, findings, recommendations, document approval and formal service. Software seats do not determine Committee composition or quorum. A draft, reminder or checklist tick does not file a complaint or appeal, serve a notice, certify compliance or extend a statutory deadline.

The Cancellation and Refund Policy and Privacy Notice apply. These terms are governed by applicable Indian law and preserve mandatory rights and remedies.
